notes: Seed dataset of outlet / organization ownership and funding. Every entry records only publicly documented facts (owner, corporate parent, funding model) plus a coarse editorial-lean label that summarizes third-party raters (AllSides, Ad Fontes, Media Bias/Fact Check, Wikipedia). 'lean' is a convenience, not our judgment; the UI links to the raters. Entries with confidence 'medium' have not been re-verified and may be out of date or wrong. Long-term plan: generate this from Wikidata (P127 'owned by', P112 founder, P8402 funder) + OpenSecrets + ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer; see docs/DATA-SOURCES.md. Optional per-outlet `funders`: [{name, what, source, verified}], each with a public primary source (the outlet's own disclosure page, a filing or a regulator), added 2026-11-04.

billionaire_individual.name: Owned by a billionaire / wealthy individual
billionaire_individual.why: One person's interests, business holdings and politics can shape coverage, directly or through self-censorship. Watch coverage of the owner's other businesses, regulators and political allies.

public_company.name: Publicly traded company
public_company.why: Accountable to shareholders and quarterly results. Incentive toward engagement, cost-cutting and advertiser-friendly coverage; dual-class shares can still give a family control.

family_controlled.name: Family-controlled
family_controlled.why: A founding family holds voting control (often via dual-class shares). Stability, but also a single family's values and interests.

private_equity_hedge_fund.name: Private equity / hedge fund
private_equity_hedge_fund.why: Financial owners optimize for extraction: cutting newsrooms, consolidating content, selling real estate. Local coverage usually shrinks. Alden Global Capital is the canonical example.

private_company.name: Privately held company
private_company.why: No public disclosure obligations. Funding and ownership chains may be opaque.

state_funded.name: Publicly / state funded, editorially independent
state_funded.why: Funded by taxpayers or licence fees under a charter that protects editorial independence (BBC, NPR, CBC, DW). Pressure can still come via budgets and board appointments.

state_controlled.name: State-controlled media
state_controlled.why: Editorial line set by a government (RT, CGTN, Sputnik). Output serves state interests; treat as official messaging, not journalism.

nonprofit_foundation.name: Nonprofit / foundation-funded
nonprofit_foundation.why: Mission-driven and donor-funded. Check who the major donors are; foundations and wealthy donors have agendas too. US 990 filings list revenue but not usually individual donors.

reader_funded.name: Reader / subscriber funded
reader_funded.why: Incentive is to please subscribers, which can mean telling an audience what it wants to hear, but it is the most transparent incentive structure.

religious_org.name: Affiliated with a religious organization
religious_org.why: Funding or ownership tied to a church or movement whose doctrine may shape coverage.

political_affiliated.name: Politically affiliated funding
political_affiliated.why: Backed by political donors, party-aligned groups or campaign-adjacent nonprofits. Advocacy, not neutral reporting.

cooperative.name: Cooperative / member-owned
cooperative.why: Owned by its members (e.g. AP is owned by US newspapers and broadcasters). Incentive toward broadly acceptable, non-partisan output.

trust.name: Owned by a trust protecting independence
trust.why: A trust whose stated purpose is editorial independence (Scott Trust / The Guardian). Still has an institutional culture and worldview.

platform.name: Technology platform / aggregator
platform.why: Selects and ranks others' content algorithmically for engagement. Ask what the ranking optimizes for.

advocacy.name: Advocacy organization / think tank
advocacy.why: Exists to advance a position. Research and 'reports' are produced to support it. Funding disclosure is often partial.

satire.name: Satire
satire.why: Intentionally fictional. Problems arise when shared out of context.

fact_check.name: Fact-checking organization
fact_check.why: Checks claims; has its own funding and selection biases worth knowing.

undisclosed_funding.name: Funding undisclosed
undisclosed_funding.why: The outlet does not publish its donors. Reporting may name a funder; check the sources on this row.
